name: Windows update ring
description: Quality updates install automatically outside active hours (7 am to 7 pm) with a 3-day deadline and a 2-day grace period. Feature updates are deferred 30 days. Drivers are excluded because the hosts are Azure VMs.
portalPath: Intune admin center > Devices > Windows updates > Update rings > Create profile: quality deferral 0, feature deferral 30, automatic update behaviour = Auto install at maintenance time, active hours 7 to 19, quality deadline 3, feature deadline 7, grace period 2, Windows drivers = Block
reviewNotes: To keep personal desktops on one Windows version for the whole pilot, add a Windows feature update policy for that version as well.
Pooled hosts are normally rebuilt from an updated image instead; this ring is for personal desktops.
